svg.title: Amazon MCF for Shopify: order to tracking
svg.desc: Check order readiness, send the fulfillment request through the integration, let Amazon MCF fulfill the order, then return shipment status and tracking to Shopify. Review rejected requests and inventory discrepancies.

g.text: From Shopify order to shipment tracking
4. Return status and tracking to Shopify
Payment · SKU mapping · Stock · Destination · Routing
Integration forwards the item, quantity, address, and service
Eligible inventory is picked, packed, and shipped
Match the order and verify customer notifications
Review exceptions: rejected requests, stock differences, missing tracking.
Thalia Technologies · Editorial diagram, not an app interface
